newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian OLOs firm after wobble on German M3.
newsitem.headline: Belgian OLOs firm after wobble on German M3.

text.p: Belgian bonds regained their composure by mid-morning on Friday, turning higher after edging down earlier in reaction to strong German M3 figures.

M3 money supply growth accelerated in May to an annualised rate of 7.0 percent from fourth quarter 1996, compared with 6.7 percent growth in April. The market meanwhile had expected a slowdown to between 6.0 and 6.5 percent.

"The market's stabilising - it's very calm," one dealer said. He was surprised the reaction to the German data had been so limited, but noted the overall trend of the figures was still in line with the Bundesbank's goals.
